video_title: Ace Bailey on adding size and training with Kevin Durant in the offseason

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on his comfort level heading into year two
quotes.excerpt: I mean in all the ways with shooting the ball, shot selections, handling the ball, defensively
quotes.quote: In all the ways with shooting the ball, shot selections, handling the ball, defensively, guarding the best players, all around.

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on his physical transformation and weight gain
quotes.excerpt: I think I'm up like 10 pounds, 10 to 12 pounds. I'm like 215, 220
quotes.quote: It definitely feels different. I think I'm up like 10 pounds, 10 to 12 pounds. I'm like 215, 220 last time I weighed in the other day. So I can feel it a lot, just me being more comfortable taking bumps and delivering bumps when it comes to just driving to the rim or mid post ups and stuff like that. I can definitely tell a difference in the game.

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on training with Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: He put a lot of knowledge into me. From just taking every rep is like a game rep
quotes.quote: For sure he put a lot of knowledge into me. From just taking every rep is like a game rep, from taking everything from dribbling, pounding the ball. Every little thing is important, from getting power from your legs or whatever. So I took a lot from him from that.

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on learning from Dwayne Wade
quotes.excerpt: He did a lot of knowledge, on and off the court
quotes.quote: He did a lot of knowledge, on and off the court. From just being in the right position, when to take the extra dribble, when to take the bump, when not to get a bump, just eating up space as you driving. It's just a lot. I can't just give it all out, but it's a lot.

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on the Jazz's young team identity
quotes.excerpt: We are a very young team, so we're very energetic
quotes.quote: We are a very young team, so we're very energetic. We are ready. This is something we all been waiting for since the end of last season, mid-summer, this summer. So it's really, really important to start the season.
